description: Execute a DPX cross-border settlement. The Settlement Agent checks oracle conditions, reasons with Claude AI, and executes on-chain (or returns sandbox result if sandbox=true). Returns settlement ID, status (executed/held/sandbox/failed), tx hash, net amount, fees, oracle conditions, and AI reasoning. Default: sandbox=true — set sandbox=false only for live execution.

destinationCurrency.description: Destination currency: USD, EUR, GBP, USDC, EURC

purpose.description: Payment purpose: intercompany, vendor-payment, payroll, treasury

quoteId.description: Pre-fetched quoteId from get_quote (optional — agent fetches live if omitted)

referenceId.description: External reference ID (invoice number, TMS ID, etc.)

sandbox.description: Sandbox mode — real calculations, no on-chain execution. Default: true.

sourceCurrency.description: Source currency: USD, EUR, GBP, USDC, EURC

name: settlement.execute

oracleScore.description: Oracle score at time of settlement

oracleStatus.description: Oracle status at time of settlement
